description: Wire all raw data sources under /raw to a queryable FastAPI backend. ETL all 7 source directories (basketball_reference, cumulative_scraped, metadata, odds, play_by_play, processed, sportsdata) into a unified SQLite database under /data/. Build a FastAPI backend in /backend/ with typed endpoints for teams, players, games, shots, play-by-play, odds, and league trends. Expose the API endpoints consumed by the frontend hooks (useShotData, useGameData, useChartData).
